messages:
tanya-sales: LatticeWorks POC blocked. CTO wants written 99.9% regional uptime commitment for Dedicated + a hard pricing cap if usage >2B tokens/mo. Also KMS BYO questions landed from their security team. Need quick internal alignment.

sam-se: Roger. Are they asking for reserved capacity or just guaranteed SLA on Dedicated?

tanya-sales: They want reserved seed capacity with a contractual SLA. CTO expects options by EOD tomorrow.

alejandra-cto: Ill draft SLA text. Need expected baseline throughput and burst numbers + what our fallback (degraded) model would look like.

ravi-infra: For sizing we need their 95th percentile token/sec. Do we have POC traces?

cora-sales-lead: Sent traces earlier. avg qps ~350, short peaks to ~1.2k. Link: https://redwood.internal/poctraces/LATT-20250412

matt-sre: 99.9% regionally is feasible with multi-AZ + warm standby. If they want financial recourse we'll require runbook + canary fallback. I'll draft a short runbook.

sam-se: Pricing cap proposal: committed baseline (reserved GPU pool) + overage with a ceiling for first 90 days. Ill sketch numbers.

pricing-bot: Template suggestion: "Committed X GPUs / Y tokens -> $Z/mo. Overage capped at 25% of committed cost for first 90 days." See /pricing/templates/enterprise-cap-floor.md

alejandra-cto: KMS BYO: we support BYO keys in Dedicated via our KMS integration, but need their key rotation policy and attestation level. Legal will request guarantees about access and auditability.

tanya-sales: Legal asked for a one-pager on KMS BYO for the customer. Can security produce by EOD?

ravi-infra: Ill produce a concise one-pager describing integration steps, constraints (no direct CMK access from our control plane), rotation expectations, and audit logs.

matt-sre: Also recommend network peering for faster failover; without peering failover latency can spike. Adding peering reduces risk.

cora-sales-lead: Customer wants assurance on fallback model quality. Can we provide evals showing parity?

sam-se: Yes. We can route to a quantized variant with similar sampling settings and run their prompt set. Need their sample prompts.

tanya-sales: Action items: @alejandra-cto SLA draft (12h), @sam-se pricing cap draft (8h), @ravi-infra KMS one-pager (EOD), @matt-sre runbook + peering rec (EOD). Ill consolidate and loop in Finance + Legal. Ping me if you need exec escalation.

pricing-bot: Note: finance approval required for credit exposure >$500k/mo. Flag early if cap implies that.

ops-bot: Added playbook: /ops/playbooks/dedicated-failover.md (timestamp 1756012400)

alejandra-cto: SLA draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drafts/lattice-sla-v1.md - includes availability calc, exclusions, remedy bands.

sam-se: Pricing draft uploaded: https://redwood.internal/drafts/lattice-pricing-cap-v1.md - two-tier cap + 90-day smoothing.

ravi-infra: KMS one-pager uploaded: https://redwood.internal/security/kms-byowhitepaper.pdf - notes: requires customer's key policy doc for enrollment.

matt-sre: Runbook slides ready for CTO sync at 15:00.

tanya-sales: Thanks. Ill update the exec after the 3pm sync. :thumbsup:
